edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord YHWH concerning Edom: We have heard a report from YHWH, and an envoy has been sent among the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!”
verses.hebrew: חֲזוֹן עֹבַדְיָה כֹּה־אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לֶאֱדוֹם שְׁמוּעָה שָׁמַעְנוּ מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְצִיר בַּגּוֹיִם שֻׁלָּח קוּמוּ וְנָקוּמָה עָלֶיהָ לַמִּלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: Look, I have made you small among the nations; you are greatly despised.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה קָטֹן נְתַתִּיךָ בַּגּוֹיִם בָּזוּי אַתָּה מְאֹד׃

verses.english: The arrogance of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in clefts of rock, whose dwelling is high, who say in your heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”
verses.hebrew: זְדוֹן לִבְּךָ הִשִּׁיאֶךָ שֹׁכְנִי בְחַגְוֵי־סֶּלַע מְרוֹם שִׁבְתּוֹ אֹמֵר בְּלִבּוֹ מִי יוֹרִדֵנִי אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Though you rise high like the eagle, though you set your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, declares YHWH.
verses.hebrew: אִם־תַּגְבִּיהַּ כַּנֶּשֶׁר וְאִם־בֵּין כּוֹכָבִים שִׂים קִנֶּךָ מִשָּׁם אוֹרִידְךָ נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: If thieves came to you, if night robbers came—how you have been destroyed!—would they not steal only their fill? If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave gleanings?
verses.hebrew: אִם־גַּנָּבִים בָּאוּ־לְךָ אִם־שׁוֹדְדֵי לַיְלָה אֵיךְ נִדְמֵיתָה הֲלוֹא יִגְנְבוּ דַּיָּם אִם־בֹּצְרִים בָּאוּ לָךְ הֲלוֹא יַשְׁאִירוּ עֹלֵלוֹת׃

verses.english: How Esau has been searched out! His hidden treasures have been sought out!
verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ נֶחְפְּשׂוּ עֵשָׂו נִבְעוּ מַצְפֻּנָיו׃

verses.english: All your covenant partners have driven you to the border; your allies have deceived you and prevailed over you. Those who eat your bread set a trap beneath you. There is no understanding in him.
verses.hebrew: עַד־הַגְּבוּל שִׁלְּחוּךָ כֹּל אַנְשֵׁי בְרִיתֶךָ הִשִּׁיאוּךָ יָכְלוּ לְךָ אַנְשֵׁי שְׁלֹמֶךָ לַחְמְךָ יָשִׂימוּ מָזוֹר תַּחְתֶּיךָ אֵין תְּבוּנָה בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Will I not, on that day, declares YHWH, destroy the wise from Edom and understanding from Mount Esau?
verses.hebrew: הֲלוֹא בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם־יְהוָה וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי חֲכָמִים מֵאֱדוֹם וּתְבוּנָה מֵהַר עֵשָׂו׃

verses.english: Your warriors will be shattered, Teman, so that every man may be cut off from Mount Esau by slaughter.
verses.hebrew: וְחַתּוּ גִבּוֹרֶיךָ תֵּימָן לְמַעַן יִכָּרֶת־אִישׁ מֵהַר עֵשָׂו מִקָּטֶל׃

verses.english: Because of violence against your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
verses.hebrew: מֵחֲמַס אָחִיךָ יַעֲקֹב תְּכַסְּךָ בוּשָׁה וְנִכְרַתָּ לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: On the day you stood aside, on the day strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
verses.hebrew: בְּיוֹם עֲמָדְךָ מִנֶּגֶד בְּיוֹם שְׁבוֹת זָרִים חֵילוֹ וְנָכְרִים בָּאוּ שערו [שְׁעָרָיו] וְעַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם יַדּוּ גוֹרָל גַּם־אַתָּה כְּאַחַד מֵהֶם׃

verses.english: Do not look on your brother's day, the day of his calamity; do not rejoice over the sons of Judah on the day of their destruction; do not boast on the day of distress.
verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תֵּרֶא בְיוֹם־אָחִיךָ בְּיוֹם נָכְרוֹ וְאַל־תִּשְׂמַח לִבְנֵי־יְהוּדָה בְּיוֹם אָבְדָם וְאַל־תַּגְדֵּל פִּיךָ בְּיוֹם צָרָה׃

verses.english: Do not enter My people's gate on the day of their disaster. Do not you too look on his misery on the day of his disaster, and do not reach out for his wealth on the day of his disaster.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תָּבוֹא בְשַׁעַר־עַמִּי בְּיוֹם אֵידָם אַל־תֵּרֶא גַם־אַתָּה בְּרָעָתוֹ בְּיוֹם אֵידוֹ וְאַל־תִּשְׁלַחְנָה בְחֵילוֹ בְּיוֹם אֵידוֹ׃

verses.english: Do not stand at the crossroads to cut off his fugitives, and do not hand over his survivors on the day of distress.
verses.hebrew: וְאַל־תַּעֲמֹד עַל־הַפֶּרֶק לְהַכְרִית אֶת־פְּלִיטָיו וְאַל־תַּסְגֵּר שְׂרִידָיו בְּיוֹם צָרָה׃

verses.english: For the day of YHWH is near against all the nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your deed will return upon your own head.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־קָרוֹב יוֹם־יְהוָה עַל־כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יֵעָשֶׂה לָּךְ גְּמֻלְךָ יָשׁוּב בְּרֹאשֶׁךָ׃

verses.english: For just as you drank on My holy mountain, all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and swallow, and they will be as though they had never been.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כַּאֲשֶׁר שְׁתִיתֶם עַל־הַר קָדְשִׁי יִשְׁתּוּ כָל־הַגּוֹיִם תָּמִיד וְשָׁתוּ וְלָעוּ וְהָיוּ כְּלוֹא הָיוּ׃

verses.english: But on Mount Zion there will be escape, and it will be holy; the house of Jacob will possess its possessions.
verses.hebrew: וּבְהַר צִיּוֹן תִּהְיֶה פְלֵיטָה וְהָיָה קֹדֶשׁ וְיָרְשׁוּ בֵּית יַעֲקֹב אֵת מוֹרָשֵׁיהֶם׃

verses.english: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble. They will burn among them and consume them, and there will be no survivor for the house of Esau, for YHWH has spoken.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בֵית־יַעֲקֹב אֵשׁ וּבֵית יוֹסֵף לֶהָבָה וּבֵית עֵשָׂו לְקַשׁ וְדָלְקוּ בָהֶם וַאֲכָלוּם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶה שָׂרִיד לְבֵית עֵשָׂו כִּי יְהוָה דִּבֵּר׃

verses.english: Those of the Negeb will possess Mount Esau, and those of the lowland the Philistines. They will possess the territory of Ephraim and the territory of Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.
verses.hebrew: וְיָרְשׁוּ הַנֶּגֶב אֶת־הַר עֵשָׂו וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּים וְיָרְשׁוּ אֶת־שְׂדֵה אֶפְרַיִם וְאֵת שְׂדֵה שֹׁמְרוֹן וּבִנְיָמִן אֶת־הַגִּלְעָד׃

verses.english: The exiles of this host of the sons of Israel will possess what belongs to the Canaanites as far as Zarephath, and the exiles of Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the cities of the Negeb.
verses.hebrew: וְגָלֻת הַחֵל־הַזֶּה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־כְּנַעֲנִים עַד־צָרְפַת וְגָלֻת יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בִּסְפָרַד יִרְשׁוּ אֵת עָרֵי הַנֶּגֶב׃

verses.english: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to judge Mount Esau, and the kingship will belong to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְעָלוּ מוֹשִׁעִים בְּהַר צִיּוֹן לִשְׁפֹּט אֶת־הַר עֵשָׂו וְהָיְתָה לַיהוָה הַמְּלוּכָה׃
